## Important
- app/cli.py:6 — correctness — Restore the deprecated `--wait` alias — For `parse_args(["--wait", "12"])`, argument parsing now exits with code 2. The parser registers only `"--timeout"`, while `docs/adr/007-timeout.md:5` promises “Accept `--wait` as an alias for one release and emit a deprecation warning when it is used.” — Existing scripts using `--wait` stop before execution, breaking compatibility during the documented transition period. — Fix: Register `--wait` with the `timeout` destination, emit its deprecation warning, and extend `test_explicit_options` to cover the alias.
